def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(grid)
    R,C=a.shape
    line_rows=[r for r in range(R) if len(set(a[r]))==1]
    line_cols=[c for c in range(C) if len(set(a[:,c]))==1]
    lc=set(a[line_rows[0]]) if line_rows else None
    cnt=Counter(a.flatten())
    bg=max((v,k) for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=lc)[1] if lc is not None else cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    stray=[k for k in cnt if k not in (lc,bg)][0]
    # row groups
    rg=[];cur=[]
    for r in range(R):
        if r in line_rows:
            if cur: rg.append(cur); cur=[]
        else: cur.append(r)
    if cur: rg.append(cur)
    cg=[];cur=[]
    for c in range(C):
        if c in line_cols:
            if cur: cg.append(cur); cur=[]
        else: cur.append(c)
    if cur: cg.append(cur)
    out=[]
    for rgp in rg:
        row=[]
        for cgp in cg:
            n=sum(1 for r in rgp for c in cgp if a[r,c]==stray)
            row.append(bg if n%2==1 else 1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
